subject: Clarify: VPC fee proration & hybrid support construct
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora@healthsync.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@healthsync.com
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on VPC pricing breakdown and support tiers

Hi David / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team is excited about the performance numbers. Procurement asked me to follow up with a short list to make sure we understand the commercial construct before formal redlines. Can you confirm the following?

1) Platform fee proration: If we start the pilot in April (15 days), how is the platform fee billed for month 1? Do you pro-rate by day or charge the full monthly band?

2) Operator vs site licenses: We expect ~3 operator seats and 4 site nodes during pilot. Can you send the SKU matrix that maps operator licenses to the platform fee? Is there a seatless option for the pilot?

3) Support tiers and response SLAs: We need clarification on what SRE hours are included in the Standard vs Premium support tiers, and whether on-call escalation (P1/P2) is included in the pilot pricing.

4) Migration / exit protection: If we move off private to hosted after 9 months, any termination fees or early amortization of platform credits?

I attached a short procurement checklist (HealthSync_Procurement_Questions.pdf). Can you loop legal and finance if necessary — Rajiv is CC'd.

Looking to get a short answer by Friday so procurement can prioritize.

Best,
Nora
Director of Infrastructure | HealthSync
From: david_kim@redwood.ai
To: Nora Patel <nora@healthsync.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, Rajiv Desai <rajiv@healthsync.com>, procurement@healthsync.com
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 12:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on VPC pricing breakdown and support tiers

Nora — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below; attaching the SKU matrix and a draft SOW for context.

1) Platform fee proration: We pro-rate platform fees daily for pilots shorter than a full month. For a 15-day pilot we would charge 50% of the monthly platform fee band. That proration is applied to the platform fee line only; usage billing runs on the normal monthly invoice.

2) Operator vs site licenses: See attached License_SKU_Matrix.xlsx. Pilot options:
  - Seat-based operator licenses (per-person admin SRE)
  - Site/node licenses (per-host inference nodes)
  - Seatless pilot: we can offer a limited seatless pilot (nodes only) for up to 30 days at a reduced platform fee (pilot discount applies) — would need an operator contact for escalation.

3) Support tiers:
  - Standard: business hours (M-F) ticketing, 8x5 response SLAs, best-effort P1 triage (escalation to engineering with next-business-day target).
  - Premium: 24x7 SRE on-call (P1 1-hour ack, P0 immediate bridge), quarterly runbooks and 2 dedicated escalation hours/month.
  - For pilot we typically include Standard + 4 hours/month of SRE time for onboarding; Premium is available as an add-on or trial for pilot at a discounted rate.

4) Exit / migration: No hard termination fee for moving to hosted, but platform fee credits (if any prepaid) are amortized over the committed period; early migration may forfeit remaining amortized credits depending on the construct in the SOW. We can include a 3-month exit protection clause for pilots moving to hosted to smooth the transition.

Next steps: Marissa will propose a commercial pilot package with explicit numbers and a canary-to-production path. Irene from legal is looped for contract language we tend to put in pilot SOWs.

Thanks,
David
Director, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
Attachments: License_SKU_Matrix.xlsx, Draft_SOW_v1.docx
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Nora Patel <nora@healthsync.com>, david_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: Rajiv Desai <rajiv@healthsync.com>, procurement@healthsync.com
Date: Thu, 2 Apr 2026 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on VPC pricing breakdown and support tiers

Hi Nora — following up with concrete commercial options so procurement has line items to review. I've put three pilot packages below (numbers illustrative; final will come in a formal quote):

Pilot Lite (30 days)
- Platform fee: $6,000 (pro-rated daily if <30 days)
- Nodes: 4 x c4-node equivalent priced at $1,200/node-month (usage billed separately)
- Operator seats: seatless option included (no operator license), escalation via named contact
- Support: Standard + 4 SRE hours onboarding

Pilot Plus (60 days)
- Platform fee: $10,500 (prorated)
- Nodes: 4 nodes + burst capacity on-demand
- Operator seats: 3 operator licenses included
- Support: Premium (14 SRE hours/month equivalent for pilot) at pilot discount

Pilot to Prod (90+ days ramp)
- Platform fee amortized across 12 months for conversion (we can offer a one-time pilot-to-prod credit equal to 25% of pilot platform fees if you commit to 12 months)
- Support bundling discounts available for 12mo commitments

I've attached a sample quote template. Two asks for procurement:
  - Confirm whether seatless pilot is acceptable (we'll need a named escalation contact).
  - Decide if you'd prefer monthly billing or a one-off pilot invoice (affects accounting).

I'll prepare a quote today and aim to have a DocuSign for signature by Monday if HealthSync is ready.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai

Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on VPC pricing breakdown and support tiers — contract note

Nora / Rajiv — quick legal note on exit protection and amortization so procurement sees what we typically allow: 

- Pilot proration: confirm daily proration applies as described. We'll include explicit language that pilot billing is prorated and usage invoices remain monthly.
- Credits: any pilot credit applied toward future committed platform fees will be itemized; credits expire if no 12-month conversion commitment within 120 days of pilot end.
- Migration assistance: we can include one migration run (knowledge-transfer + export tooling) as a line-item in the SOW for no extra fee; additional bespoke migration work billed via time & materials.
- Termination: We do not seek liquidated damages; instead the SOW will include an amortization schedule for any prepaid credits and a mutual exit plan documenting data egress paths and observability handover.

I've proposed redline language and attached a slim SOW template (Draft_SOW_v1.docx) — happy to iterate.

Irene Choi
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
